contracts: Per-stamp claimed area, ownership/counter/grid/version and dirty row parity
Growth and ancillary ownership with both native and legacy flags
Exact submitted GPU attribute bytes/order and recorded authoritative splat packets
Pooled record release/reuse, old seven-slot records and hidden presentation snapshots
Stable shelf packing and failed-trial atomicity
validation.nativeSettledAndCellCacheSlots: Dedicated two-second native wall drip verifies exact replay and integer/bounded per-face cache slots for eight-slot entries.

limitations: Node actual-module parity and allocation/call suppression are verified; physical-device FPS, GPU pixels and retail behavioral comparisons are not measured.
The eighth slot adds one transient Number per accepted face; arrays remain under the existing bounded pooling and release lifecycle.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy CPU paint grid: short-circuit two provably unnecessary hypot paths
items.reason: Only the exact roller rectangle interior substitutes +0 for hypot(max(qa,0),max(qb,0)); the existing stronger ordinary squared outer/inner gates are kept. Real CPU stamp outputs, dirty rows, ownership order, counters and grid are identical across legacy/native cases.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy ink growth: cache per-face projection radius rather than sqrt each redraw
items.reason: Cache the unclamped per-face projection in the eighth slot with an explicit stride and radius identity. Admission retains its clamp/NaN/signed-zero behavior; seven-slot external records and radius changes fall back. Pool release, ancillary ownership, hidden snapshots and both native/robo instrumentation consumers use the correct stride.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Legacy塗りアトラスの棚詰め失敗リトライ時の矩形レコード再利用
items.reason: One layout-local record set and working array are reused across retries. Each trial restores original face order, recomputes exact sizes and uses the unchanged stable comparator/shelf packing. Failed trials never publish atlas writes. The existing native layout path and standalone _tryPack default remain unchanged.
